verdict.rationale: The only in-product AI evidence is a narrow, automated agent: the pricing page's "Invoice Coding Agent" for multi-line bill coding, plus marketing language about "AI-powered spend management" that auto-categorizes transactions. Nothing shows a general assistant that users can hand arbitrary tasks to, and the documentation MCP server is a developer-docs tool rather than an in-product assistant. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant that accepts user-delegated tasks, documentation of how users interact with or direct it, Spend & Expense-specific agent capabilities beyond categorization, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
